title: Local section generated by an integer extension by zero
statement: For an abelian sheaf F on X, an open U and section s in F(U), there is a morphism from the extension by zero to F of the constant integer sheaf on U such that at every x in U its stalk image contains the germ of s.

source.place: Lemma 02UX, first paragraph: each local section gives a map from j_! Z_U

proof.text: On each open of U send an integer to its multiple of the restriction of s. Naturality follows from additivity and the presheaf composition law. Sheafify to get alpha from the constant integer sheaf to F restricted to U. Apply extension by zero and compose with its counit. The germ of the extension section of the sheafification unit applied to integer 1 maps to the germ of s: extension-section naturality, the counit section formula, and the sheafification lift identity reduce this to the identity transport on U.

lean.statement:
theorem abelianSheaf_local_integer_generator
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (F : X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (U : Opens X) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ f : (TopCat.Sheaf.abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
        ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
          AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⟶ F,
      ∀ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U),
        ∃ z : Presheaf.stalk (C := AddCommGrpCat.{u})
            (((TopCat.Sheaf.abelianOpenExtensionByZero U).obj
              ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj U))
                AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).obj) x,
          (Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map f.hom z =
            Presheaf.germ F.obj U x hx s
